<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#2c101e">
<title>For Monisha | A Little World of Us</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Dancing+Script:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap');
:root{--wine:#581d35;--rose:#d86c88;--cream:#fff8f1;--ink:#4a2634;--gold:#d8b77c}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:4px}
#particles{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;z-index:20}
.particle{position:absolute;bottom:-35px;animation:drift linear forwards;opacity:.75}
@keyframes drift{to{transform:translateY(-115vh) rotate(35deg);opacity:0}}
.hero{min-height:100svh;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;padding:50px 20px;color:#fff4f2;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 20%,#78334c 0,#421d30 45%,#20121c 100%);position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
.hero:before,.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;border:1px solid #e9bdc13d;border-radius:50%;width:min(78vw,680px);aspect-ratio:1;z-index:-1;animation:rotate 35s linear infinite}
.hero:after{width:min(58vw,490px);animation-direction:reverse}
@keyframes rotate{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.eyebrow{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.28em;font-size:.68rem;color:var(--gold);margin:0 0 20px}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:"Dancing Script",cursive;font-weight:500}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(4rem,11vw,8.5rem);line-height:.95;margin:0;color:#fff1ed}
.hero .sub{max-width:560px;line-height:1.9;margin:24px auto 28px;color:#f2dfe3;font-size:.95rem}
.glow-heart{font-size:2.8rem;display:block;margin-bottom:22px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px #ff8eae);animation:beat 1.8s infinite}
@keyframes beat{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.12)}}
.btn{border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:999px;padding:13px 23px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e99aaf,#c9587a);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 9px 28px #68283b2b;transition:.25s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 12px 32px #68283b45}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:inherit;border-color:currentColor;box-shadow:none}
.btn.dark{background:var(--wine)}
section{padding:88px 20px;text-align:center}
.section-inner{width:min(100%,1000px);margin:auto}
.section-kicker{font-size:.67rem;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#b45a75;margin-bottom:14px}
h2{font-size:clamp(2.8rem,7vw,5rem);line-height:1.02;margin:0 0 18px;color:var(--wine)}
.lead{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto 30px;line-height:1.85;color:#805b68;font-size:.94rem}
.hidden{display:none!important}
#letter{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff8f1,#f9e5e9)}
.envelope-wrap{width:min(90vw,440px);margin:34px auto 22px;perspective:1000px}
.envelope{height:260px;position:relative;background:#eab9c4;border-radius:4px 4px 12px 12px;box-shadow:0 25px 60px #6c293522;cursor:pointer;isolation:isolate}
.envelope:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f5d5d9,#e5a9b7);clip-path:polygon(0 0,50% 58%,100% 0);z-index:3;transform-origin:top;transition:transform 1s ease}
.envelope:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(35deg,#d88ea2,#f3cbd2);clip-path:polygon(0 100%,0 0,50% 56%,100% 0,100% 100%);z-index:2}
.envelope .seal{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:50%;top:53%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:#9f3454;color:#fff4f2;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.35rem;box-shadow:0 3px 9px #72253d44;transition:.4s}
.envelope .paper{position:absolute;z-index:1;left:7%;right:7%;bottom:5%;height:86%;background:#fffaf2;padding:25px 22px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;transition:transform 1s ease,bottom 1s ease;box-shadow:0 2px 12px #652d3b18;overflow:hidden}
.envelope .paper strong{font:2.2rem "Dancing Script",cursive;color:#a34461}
.envelope .paper span{font-size:.72rem;line-height:1.6;margin-top:8px}
.envelope.open:before{transform:rotateX(180deg);z-index:0}
.envelope.open .seal{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.2)}
.envelope.open .paper{transform:translateY(-68px);bottom:5%;height:100%;z-index:5;transition-delay:.35s}
.envelope-hint{font-size:.76rem;color:#9e6b7b}
.letter-paper{max-width:720px;margin:28px auto 0;padding:clamp(25px,5vw,48px);background:#fffdf8;border:1px solid #f1d8dc;box-shadow:0 18px 45px #6c29350e;text-align:left;line-height:1.95;font-size:.95rem}
.letter-paper p,.dream-card p,.final-note p{margin:0 0 1.2em}
.letter-paper .salutation,.letter-paper .signature{font:2rem "Dancing Script",cursive;color:#a34461;margin-bottom:.5em}
#timeline{background:#fffdf9}
.timeline{max-width:760px;margin:45px auto 0;text-align:left;position:relative}
.timeline:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:20px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:1px;background:#e7b8c5}
.moment{position:relative;padding:0 0 32px 58px}
.moment:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.moment:before{content:"♡";position:absolute;left:7px;top:0;width:27px;height:27px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#fff0f3;border:1px solid #e7b8c5;color:#bd5b78}
.moment .date{font-size:.67rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.17em;color:#b45a75}
.moment h3{font-size:2rem;margin:5px 0;color:var(--wine)}
.moment p{line-height:1.8;font-size:.88rem;color:#805b68;margin:0}
.note{font-size:.85rem;color:#9b7883;margin:25px auto;max-width:560px;line-height:1.8}
#garden{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f9e6eb,#fff7f0)}
.rose-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:15px;max-width:760px;margin:35px auto}
.rose-card{background:#ffffffb8;border:1px solid #fff;border-radius:18px;padding:22px 12px;min-height:155px;transition:.25s}
.rose-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px)}
.rose{font-size:3rem;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 7px #a63b5520);transition:transform .3s}
.rose-card:hover .rose{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.12)}
.rose-card span:last-child{display:block;font-size:.76rem;margin-top:10px;color:#875467}
.rose-message{max-width:600px;min-height:75px;margin:20px auto 0;padding:20px;background:#fffdf9;border-radius:16px;font:1.6rem/1.5 "Dancing Script",cursive;color:#a34461;box-shadow:0 8px 25px #6c29350c}
#reasons{background:#fffdf9}
.reason-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:15px;margin:38px auto;max-width:900px}
.reason-card{border:1px solid #f0d8dd;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;min-height:160px;padding:20px 15px;text-align:center;transition:.3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.reason-card .front{display:flex;height:100%;min-height:115px;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.reason-card .front b{font:1.7rem "Dancing Script",cursive;color:#a34461;font-weight:500}
.reason-card .back{display:none;font-size:.83rem;line-height:1.7;color:#805b68}
.reason-card.revealed{background:#fff0f3;transform:translateY(-3px)}
.reason-card.revealed .front{display:none}
.reason-card.revealed .back{display:block}
.reason-card .icon{font-size:1.6rem}
#future{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#2b1521,#572239);color:#f9e7e8}
#future h2{color:#fff0ed}
#future .lead{color:#e9cbd3}
.dream-card{max-width:720px;margin:30px auto;padding:35px;border:1px solid #e5b4c34a;border-radius:22px;background:#ffffff09;line-height:2;color:#f8e8e8;text-align:left}
#final{min-height:100svh;display:grid;place-items:center;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#7a304b 0,#3a1b2b 54%,#1d1019 100%);color:#fff0ed;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
#final h2{color:#fff0ed}
#final .lead{color:#f2dce2}
.final-heart{font-size:4rem;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 20px #ff93b0);animation:beat 1.7s infinite}
.final-note{max-width:650px;margin:25px auto;padding:30px;border:1px solid #e6c0c34a;background:#ffffff08;border-radius:20px;line-height:2;text-align:left}
.song{max-width:480px;margin:28px auto 0}
.song p{font-size:.8rem;color:#e8cbd2;margin:0 0 10px}
.song iframe{border:0;border-radius:12px;width:100%}

#gallery{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff8f1,#f9e5e9)}
.g-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:22px;max-width:1100px;margin:40px auto}
.g-card{background:#fffdf9;border:1px solid #f1d8dc;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 12px 30px #6c29350f;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left}
.g-card .imgbtn{border:0;padding:0;background:#f5d5d9;cursor:zoom-in;display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5}
.g-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.g-card .ph{display:grid;place-items:center;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:3rem;color:#d86c88}
.g-card .info{padding:16px 18px 8px}
.g-card .gdate{font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.17em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#b45a75}
.g-card h3{font-size:1.7rem;margin:4px 0 6px;color:var(--wine)}
.g-card p{margin:0;font-size:.84rem;line-height:1.75;color:#805b68}
.songbox{margin:10px 18px 18px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:14px;background:#fff0f3;border:1px solid #f0d0d8}
.songbox .stitle{font-size:.72rem;color:#a34461;margin-bottom:6px;display:block}
.songbox audio{width:100%;height:36px}
.songbox iframe{border:0;border-radius:12px;width:100%;height:152px}
.songbox.empty{border-style:dashed;text-align:center;color:#a8808d;font-size:.74rem;padding:16px 12px}
.g-card .gvid{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:contain;background:#2c101e;display:block}
#lb{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#1d1019ee;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;padding:20px;z-index:50;cursor:zoom-out;text-align:center}
#lb.on{display:flex}
#lb img{max-width:min(92vw,720px);max-height:72vh;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #0008}
#lb .cap{color:#f6dfe5;max-width:560px;margin-top:16px;line-height:1.7;font-size:.9rem}
#lb .cap b{display:block;font:500 1.8rem "Dancing Script",cursive;color:#f1bdca}

#crush{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff7f0,#f9e6eb)}
.love-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:18px;max-width:1000px;margin:38px auto}
.love-card{background:#fffdf9;border:1px solid #f0d8dd;border-radius:20px;padding:26px 22px;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 10px 28px #6c29350d;transition:.25s}
.love-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
.love-card .em{font-size:2.2rem;display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
.love-card h3{font-size:2rem;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--wine)}
.love-card p{margin:0;font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.85;color:#805b68}
#forever{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#6b2a43 0,#35192a 60%,#1d1019 100%);color:#fff0ed}
#forever h2{color:#fff0ed}
#forever .lead{color:#f2dce2}
.forever-note{max-width:680px;margin:26px auto;padding:34px 30px;border:1px solid #e6c0c34a;background:#ffffff0a;border-radius:22px;line-height:2;text-align:left}
.forever-note p{margin:0 0 1.2em}
.forever-note .big{font:500 clamp(1.9rem,5vw,2.6rem)/1.35 "Dancing Script",cursive;color:#f1bdca;text-align:center;margin:1.2em 0}

.pn{font-family:"Dancing Script",cursive;font-weight:600;color:#ff4f8b;text-shadow:0 0 14px #ff4f8b55;white-space:nowrap}
#forever .pn,#final .pn,#future .pn,.hero .pn{color:#ff7aa8;text-shadow:0 0 16px #ff7aa888}
.fname{position:absolute;bottom:-60px;font-family:"Dancing Script",cursive;font-weight:600;color:#ff4f8b;text-shadow:0 0 14px #ff4f8b66,0 0 2px #fff;white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;animation:floatname linear forwards}
@keyframes floatname{0%{transform:translate(0,0) rotate(-4deg);opacity:0}10%{opacity:.8}50%{transform:translate(calc(var(--sx)*.5),-60vh) rotate(4deg)}90%{opacity:.7}100%{transform:translate(var(--sx),-125vh) rotate(-3deg);opacity:0}}
.particle.glow{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px #ff7aa8)}
.tap-heart{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;z-index:30;animation:tap 1.4s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes tap{to{transform:translate(var(--dx),-120px) scale(1.4);opacity:0}}

body.locked{overflow:hidden;height:100svh}
#gate{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;padding:30px;color:#fff4f2;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,#6b2a43 0,#2c101e 55%,#14090f 100%);transition:opacity 1.2s ease,transform 1.4s ease,visibility 1.4s}
#gate.leave{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.25);visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
#gate .stars{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden}
#gate .star{position:absolute;width:3px;height:3px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffd9e4;animation:tw 3s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes tw{0%,100%{opacity:.15;transform:scale(.7)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.4)}}
#gate .g-in{position:relative;max-width:520px}
#gate .g-heart{font-size:3.2rem;display:block;margin-bottom:18px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 22px #ff8eae);animation:beat 1.8s infinite}
#gate .g-welcome{font:500 clamp(1.5rem,5.5vw,2.3rem)/1.3 "Dancing Script",cursive;color:#ffd9e4;margin:0 0 6px;min-height:1.4em}
#gate .g-hello{font:600 clamp(4rem,19vw,8rem)/1 "Dancing Script",cursive;margin:0 0 22px;min-height:1.1em;color:#ff7aa8;text-shadow:0 0 28px #ff4f8b99,0 0 60px #ff4f8b55}
#gate .g-line{font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.9;color:#f2dfe3;min-height:5.6em;margin:0 0 26px}
#gate .btn{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);transition:.8s;pointer-events:none}
#gate .btn.show{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
#gate .caret::after{content:"|";margin-left:2px;animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
#places{position:fixed;right:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:40;display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
body.entered #places{display:flex}
#places a{position:relative;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff4f8b55;border:1px solid #ff4f8b;display:block;transition:.3s}
#places a.on{background:#ff4f8b;box-shadow:0 0 12px #ff4f8b;transform:scale(1.3)}
#places a span{position:absolute;right:20px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);white-space:nowrap;font-size:.7rem;background:#2c101ee6;color:#ffd9e4;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:99px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.25s}
#places a:hover span{opacity:1}
@media(max-width:700px){#places{right:7px;gap:9px}#places a{width:8px;height:8px}#places a span{display:none}}
.dream-card.collapsed{max-height:430px;overflow:hidden;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 55%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 55%,transparent)}
.more{margin-top:-6px}
footer{text-align:center;background:#1d1019;color:#cba8b4;padding:25px;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.04em}
@media(max-width:620px){section{padding:70px 17px}.rose-grid,.reason-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.envelope{height:225px}.letter-paper{font-size:.88rem}.dream-card{padding:25px 20px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body class="locked">
<div id="gate" role="dialog" aria-label="Welcome">
  <div class="stars" id="stars" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="g-in">
    <span class="g-heart">♡</span>
    <p class="g-welcome" id="gWelcome"></p>
    <h1 class="g-hello caret" id="gHello"></h1>
    <p class="g-line" id="gLine"></p>
    <button class="btn" id="gBtn" onclick="enterWorld()">Step inside ✨</button>
  </div>
</div>
<nav id="places" aria-label="Places in this little world"></nav>
<div id="particles" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<header class="hero">
  <div>
    <span class="glow-heart">♡</span>
    <p class="eyebrow">A little world made just for you</p>
    <h1>For <span class="pn">Monisha</span></h1>
    <p class="sub">Some feelings are too big for a simple text. So I built you a whole little world, full of memories, roses, and a few shameless things I can only say here. Warning: you may blush. 😏</p>
    <button class="btn" onclick="goTo('letter')">Open your little surprise ✉</button>
    <p style="font-size:.7rem;color:#d8b7c2;margin-top:22px">Made with care, just for you</p>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
<section id="letter">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <p class="section-kicker">01 · The Letterbox</p>
    <h2>Something for you</h2>
    <p class="lead">Tap the envelope to open it. Take your time. This little letter is meant to be read slowly.</p>
    <div class="envelope-wrap">
      <div class="envelope" id="envelope" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Open the letter" onclick="openEnvelope()" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();openEnvelope()}">
        <div class="paper"><strong>For you, <span class="pn">Monisha</span></strong><span>A few words I wanted you to have, whenever you need them. ♡</span></div>
        <div class="seal">♡</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="envelope-hint" id="envelopeHint">Tap the envelope to open your letter</p>
    <article class="letter-paper hidden" id="letterPaper">
      <div class="salutation">My dear <span class="pn">Monisha</span>,</div>
      <p>There is no logic when it comes to you. One look, one smile, and my heart drops everything and chooses you, every single time. Honestly, it's embarrassing how easy you make it. ❤️</p>
      <p>The more I get to know you, the more reasons you give me to fall for you, and the funny part is, I was never looking for a way out. 😉</p>
      <p>I wish you could borrow my eyes for a moment and see yourself the way I see you. Maybe then you'd understand why, even on my busiest days, one little thought of you is enough to make me smile like an idiot. 🫣</p>
      <p>I don't just want to love you when you're happy and everything feels right. I want to be there when you're tired, when life gets difficult, and when you don't have the words to explain what's wrong, and all you need is someone who understands without making you explain a hundred times. 🫶🏻</p>
      <p>I may never find the perfect words for what you mean to me, so I want my actions to say what my words can't. I want to be someone you can trust and lean on, someone who celebrates your dreams as if they were his own.</p>
      <p>I can't promise a perfect life, but I promise to keep trying to make yours softer and more beautiful in every way I can. ❤️</p>
      <p>And if you ever ask what I want in return, just give me that smile of yours, let me steal a little of your time, and maybe let me be the reason for a few of those butterflies. 🦋</p>
      <div class="signature">With affection, always ♡</div>
      <p style="font-size:.78rem;color:#9b7883;margin-top:12px">Whenever and wherever, I will love you like my breath, till my last day.</p>
    </article>
    <button class="btn dark" style="margin-top:28px" onclick="goTo('timeline')">Walk through our story ↓</button>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="timeline">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <p class="section-kicker">02 · Memory Lane</p>
    <h2>Our story, one moment at a time</h2>
    <p class="lead">A relationship is built from tiny moments as much as big ones: day by day, with a lot of love, and with forgiveness after the hard moments. Love is not about finding new people. It is about choosing the same person again and again, even after all the fights.</p>
    <div class="timeline">
      <div class="moment"><span class="date">Melted in her eyes</span><h3>Awww <span class="pn">Monishaaa</span>...</h3><p>When I saw you for the first time, I felt a connection I couldn't explain. I had never felt it before. I still remember how it started, like a whole garden of memories with you in every corner.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><span class="date">Caught in her smile</span><h3>A memory that stays</h3><p>We understood each other from the start. It felt like we were meant to be together, and every moment since has reminded me of that. I never looked for perfection, only a better connection, flaws and all.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><span class="date">Kingdom of Love</span><h3>My Queen</h3><p>You have been my first priority for as long as I've loved you. You are already the queen of my kingdom, and you will always be treated like one, by me and by my family too.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><span class="date">Towards Destiny</span><h3>The next page</h3><p>No need to predict the whole future. Let's leave room for good conversations, new memories, and taking things one step at a time. I won't walk away, and I'll never make you feel low for choosing me. Every day with you, my Queen, is worth celebrating.</p></div>
    </div>
    <p class="note">I can't hand you the whole world, but I can promise to show up for you, in any situation, every time.</p>
    <button class="btn dark" onclick="goTo('garden')">Visit the rose garden 🌹</button>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="garden">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <p class="section-kicker">03 · The Rose Garden</p>
    <h2>A garden of little messages</h2>
    <p class="lead">Every rose holds a different note. Tap one to discover it.</p>
    <div class="rose-grid">
      <button class="rose-card" onclick="showRose(0)"><span class="rose">🌹</span><span>Rose of warmth</span></button>
      <button class="rose-card" onclick="showRose(1)"><span class="rose">🌷</span><span>Rose of admiration</span></button>

<section id="crush">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <p class="section-kicker">05 · Confession Corner</p>
    <h2>Completely obsessed with you</h2>
    <p class="lead">Fair warning: this part is shameless. I tried to play it cool, but it's impossible when it comes to you. 😏</p>
    <div class="love-grid">
      <div class="love-card"><span class="em">👀</span><h3>Your eyes</h3><p>I could lose myself in them and never look for the way out. One look from you and every thought in my head goes quiet. They say the eyes can't lie, and yours say everything. I can't resist them, I'm completely lost in your eyes. I wish you could see yourself through my eyes, then you'd know how much I love you.</p></div>
      <div class="love-card"><span class="em">💋</span><h3>Your lips</h3><p>That smile starts there, and it ruins me every time. I'll admit it, I get distracted mid-sentence. Some days I just want to look at you and say nothing at all. Sometimes I'd love to steal a tiny bite, but I know you're not that comfortable with me yet. If I ever get the chance, I'd taste it just once. 😏</p></div>
      <div class="love-card"><span class="em">🌸</span><h3>Your cheeks</h3><p>Soft, chubby, and made to be kissed. When you blush, my whole day is complete with just your simple smile. I'd spend a lifetime finding new ways to make you do it. I want to play with your cheeks until you say "stop annoying me" like a baby. Aww Monishaaa, I want it badly.</p></div>
      <div class="love-card"><span class="em">🩷</span><h3>Your hair</h3><p>It tends to annoy me when I'm staring at you, because it blocks my view of your whole look. But lately I've gotten addicted to it. How, I don't know, I'm still figuring it out.</p></div>
      <div class="love-card"><span class="em">✨</span><h3>Your words</h3><p>The way you talk to me, and about me and us, I respect every single word. I'd do whatever you ask, and even the smallest thing you say, I remember and do it for you, my love. 😉</p></div>
      <div class="love-card"><span class="em">🔥</span><h3>Your look</h3><p>That one glance when you know exactly what you're doing. You can stop me in my tracks without a single word, and I'm never getting over it. I'm so hopelessly yours. Step into your kingdom and start ruling my heart as yours, because you're such a pretty and hot Queen of my Heart.</p></div>
    </div>
    <p class="note">The truth is, it's not just your looks. It's the person behind all of it that I'm obsessed with. I love you with my whole heart, and my whole life is dedicated to you. I'm here to do it all for you. 🩷</p>
    <button class="btn dark" onclick="goTo('gallery')">Our beautiful memories 📸</button>

<section id="forever">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <p class="section-kicker">07 · The Quiet Place</p>
    <h2>What I truly feel</h2>
    <p class="lead">No jokes, no teasing. Just the truest thing I know.</p>
    <div class="forever-note">
      <p><span class="pn">Monisha</span>, I've said a lot of words on this page. This is the one that matters most: what I feel for you is real, and it isn't going anywhere.</p>
      <p>You are the first thought in my morning and the last one at night. You are in my good days and in my worst ones. You became the calm I didn't know I was looking for.</p>
      <p>If I live a long life, and I hope I live it with you, then on the last day of it, when everything else fades, you will still be the one I remember. My thoughts will go to your smile, your voice, and every moment we shared.</p>
      <div class="big">Even in my last seven minutes,<br>it will be you I remember.<br>You are my 7 minutes, and my life is yours.</div>
      <p>I don't say that to put weight on you. I say it because it's the truest way I know to tell you how much you mean to me. What I give you, I give freely, and I'll spend my life trying to deserve you.</p>
      <p style="margin:0;text-align:center;font-size:1.1rem">I love you, <span class="pn">Monisha</span>. Today, tomorrow, and always. 🩷</p>
    </div>
    <button class="btn" onclick="goTo('future')">A little dream 🌙</button>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="future">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <p class="section-kicker">08 · The Dreamhouse</p>
    <h2>A dream, not a demand</h2>
    <p class="lead">The future doesn't need to be figured out all at once.</p>
    <div class="dream-card collapsed" id="dreamCard">
      <p>To my <span class="pn">Monishaaa</span>… my Angel, my Stressburster, my Luckycharm… 🩷🥹</p>
      <p>There's something my heart has been wanting to tell you. I don't think I'll ever fit everything I feel into words, but today I want to try.</p>
      <p>Even when everything around me felt like chaos, when life was full of pain, stress, and uncertainty, you were there like the brightest light in a dark room. You brought light into my difficult days in ways you might not even realise. ❤️‍🩹</p>
      <p>Seeing you happy, peaceful, successful, and proud of yourself is one of the things I wish for most. Whenever life gets hard for you, you don't have to face it alone. I'll be in front of you when you need someone to stand up for you, beside you when you need someone to walk with you, and behind you when you need quiet support. 🫂</p>
      <p>When I look back, so much has changed. In 2023, I went through my major operation. In 2024, I received my offer from Finulent. In 2025, I received my offer from Enphase. Those are milestones I'll always remember.</p>
      <p>But somewhere between all those struggles, changes, and achievements, there was you.</p>
      <p>Thank you for making my life more beautiful, for teaching me to be more responsible, and for helping me understand love in ways I didn't know before. Thank you for being part of the person I'm becoming.</p>
      <p>I know we haven't always had the easiest journey. We've had fights, misunderstandings, and days when we struggled to understand each other. I won't pretend it has all been perfect. But I've learned that a meaningful bond isn't about never having problems. It's about learning from them and becoming better people.</p>
      <p>You've forgiven my mistakes, corrected me when I was wrong, and helped me see what I needed to change. I don't take that lightly. Trust, respect, and peace are built through actions, not just words, and I want to keep becoming someone who brings you comfort and security. 💞</p>
      <p>I don't just want to be someone who says "I love you." I want to be someone whose actions make you feel loved. I want to celebrate your smallest achievements like they're the biggest victories, listen when you have a thousand thoughts running through your mind, and be there for your silly moments, your happy days, your stressful evenings, and the days you don't feel like explaining anything at all.</p>
      <p>And if life gives us the chance to build a future together, I dream of something simple and beautiful: a peaceful little home, silly arguments over small things, cooking together, laughing over nonsense, and ending each day with someone who genuinely cares. Maybe a little 2BHK filled with our laughter and our own kind of happiness. 🏡</p>
      <p>I know love can't be forced, and I never want my feelings to become a burden on your heart. I want whatever grows between us to be genuine, peaceful, and chosen by both of us. Your happiness matters to me, and so does what your heart truly feels.</p>
      <p>But if you ask what my heart wishes for… more beautiful memories with you. More laughter. More understanding. More moments where we choose patience over anger. And, if someday your heart feels the same, the privilege of calling you my person for life. 🩷</p>
      <p>And if you ever ask me, "Why me?", I'll probably smile and say: "I don't know how to explain it, <span class="pn">Monisha</span>. My heart found something in you it never wanted to treat as ordinary." 🥹</p>
      <p>I can't promise a life without difficulties, but I can promise to keep working on myself, to respect your feelings, and to be honest about mine. I want my love to be something you feel in the way I treat you, not just something you read in a message. 💌</p>
      <p style="margin:0">With lots of love, always your Angel's… Stressburster's… Luckycharm's person. 🌹</p>
    </div>
    <button class="btn dark more" id="moreBtn" onclick="expandDream()">Keep reading ♡</button><br><br>
    <button class="btn" onclick="goTo('final')">One last little surprise ✨</button>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="final">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <p class="section-kicker">09 · The Last Surprise</p>
    <span class="final-heart">♡</span>
    <h2>One last thing, <span class="pn">Monisha</span></h2>
    <p class="lead">If this little corner of the internet made you smile, blush, or hide your face in your hands, then it has done exactly what I hoped. 😘</p>
    <div class="final-note" id="finalNote">
      <p><span class="pn">Monishaaa</span>, my Angel… 🥹❤️</p>
      <p>You deserve kindness on your hardest days, laughter on your ordinary days, and someone who makes you feel loved, respected, and appreciated in the little things.</p>
      <p>If you choose me, I want to be that person. I want to make you smile when you're stressed, celebrate your little wins, listen to your endless stories, and stand beside you through every high and low. Even during our fights, I want us to learn, understand each other, and choose kindness over ego.</p>
      <p>I can't promise to be perfect, but I promise to keep trying to be better for us. I want to be your safe place and your biggest supporter, the person you can be yourself with, without pretending.</p>
      <p><strong>I don't know what the future holds, but if I could choose, I'd love to build a beautiful little life with you, filled with silly fights, endless laughter, random hugs, and lots of love.</strong> 🫂</p>
      <p>Thank you for being part of my story, my Luckycharm. And if you let me, I'd love to be part of your forever. 🩷🌷</p>
      <p style="font:2.3rem 'Dancing Script',cursive;color:#f1bdca;margin:0">Made with care, just for you. ♡</p>
    </div>

const SPOT=[

"0FTPiuMAGuvXVjeXh7g8ot", /* 02 · Our Bond - Easy conversation */
"668ZUFIUNRyIqOORiCfFY3", /* 03 · Feel in your eyes - Stolen glances */

/* Embedded video for memory 06 (Surprise at college) */
const VIDEO06="data:video/mp4;base64,";

const dates=RAW.map((d,i)=>{const n=String(i+1).padStart(2,"0");const o=d[3]||{};return{date:d[0],title:d[1],text:d[2],image:IMGS[i],video:o.video?VIDEO06:"",pos:o.pos||"center",alt:`Photo: ${d[0]} - ${d[1]}`,file:`music/date${n}.mp3`,spotify:SPOT[i],songTitle:""}});

const gGrid=document.getElementById("gGrid");
function emptySong(box){box.className="songbox empty";box.innerHTML="♫ Song for this date";}
dates.forEach((d,i)=>{
  const c=document.createElement("article");c.className="g-card";
  const media=d.video
    ?`<video class="gvid" controls playsinline preload="metadata" poster="${d.image}" src="${d.video}" aria-label="${d.alt}"></video>`
    :`<button type="button" class="imgbtn" aria-label="View larger: ${d.title}"><img src="${d.image}" alt="${d.alt}" loading="lazy" style="object-position:${d.pos}"></button>`;
  c.innerHTML=`${media}
  <div class="info"><span class="gdate">${d.date}</span><h3>${d.title}</h3><p>${d.text}</p></div>
  <div class="songbox"></div>`;
  const img=c.querySelector("img");
  if(img){img.onerror=()=>{img.parentElement.innerHTML='<span class="ph" aria-hidden="true">♡</span>'};c.querySelector(".imgbtn").onclick=()=>openLb(i);}
  const box=c.querySelector(".songbox");
  const label=d.songTitle||`Our song · ${d.date}`;
  if(d.spotify){
    box.innerHTML=`<span class="stitle">♫ ${label}</span><iframe src="https://open.spotify.com/embed/track/${d.spotify}" allow="encrypted-media" loading="lazy" title="${label}"></iframe>`;
  }else if(d.file){
    box.innerHTML=`<span class="stitle">♫ ${label}</span>`;
    const a=document.createElement("audio");a.controls=true;a.preload="none";a.src=d.file;
    a.onerror=()=>emptySong(box);
    a.onplay=()=>document.querySelectorAll("#gGrid audio").forEach(o=>{if(o!==a)o.pause()});
    box.appendChild(a);
  }else emptySong(box);
  gGrid.appendChild(c);
});
const lb=document.getElementById("lb");
function openLb(i){const d=dates[i];document.getElementById("lbImg").src=d.image;document.getElementById("lbImg").alt=d.alt;document.getElementById("lbCap").innerHTML=`<b>${d.date} · ${d.title}</b>${d.text}`;lb.classList.add("on")}
function closeLb(){lb.classList.remove("on")}
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape")closeLb()});

/* ---- Welcome gate ---- */
(function(){
  const st=document.getElementById("stars");
  for(let i=0;i<60;i++){const d=document.createElement("i");d.className="star";d.style.left=Math.random()*100+"%";d.style.top=Math.random()*100+"%";d.style.animationDelay=Math.random()*3+"s";st.appendChild(d)}
  const lines=["Someone made a little world, just for you.","No hurry here. Wander, tap things, and smile a bit.","Ready to step inside?"];
  const welcome=document.getElementById("gWelcome"),hello=document.getElementById("gHello"),line=document.getElementById("gLine"),btn=document.getElementById("gBtn");
  const calm=matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const wait=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,calm?0:ms));
  async function type(el,txt,sp){el.textContent="";for(const c of txt){el.textContent+=c;await wait(sp)}}
  (async()=>{
    await wait(700);
    await type(welcome,"Welcome, my Queen, to your world",55);await wait(400);await type(hello,"Monishaaa ♡",110);
    hello.classList.remove("caret");
    for(const l of lines){await type(line,l,34);await wait(1100)}
    btn.classList.add("show");btn.focus({preventScroll:true});
  })();
})();
function enterWorld(){
  document.getElementById("gate").classList.add("leave");
  document.body.classList.remove("locked");
  document.body.classList.add("entered");
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
  for(let i=0;i<45;i++) setTimeout(()=>makeParticle(true),i*40);
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++) setTimeout(makeName,i*250);
}
/* ---- Reveal on scroll + places nav ---- */
(function(){
  const els=document.querySelectorAll(".section-inner > *, .hero > div");
  const io="IntersectionObserver" in window?new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add("in");io.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.12}):null;
  els.forEach(el=>{el.classList.add("reveal");io?io.observe(el):el.classList.add("in")});
  const names={letter:"The Letterbox",timeline:"Memory Lane",garden:"The Rose Garden",reasons:"The Little Things",crush:"Confession Corner",gallery:"The Gallery of Us",forever:"The Quiet Place",future:"The Dreamhouse",final:"The Last Surprise"};
  const nav=document.getElementById("places");
  Object.keys(names).forEach(id=>{const a=document.createElement("a");a.href="#"+id;a.setAttribute("aria-label",names[id]);a.innerHTML="<span>"+names[id]+"</span>";a.onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();goTo(id)};a.dataset.id=id;nav.appendChild(a)});
  if(io){
    const so=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){nav.querySelectorAll("a").forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle("on",a.dataset.id===e.target.id))}}),{threshold:.4});
    Object.keys(names).forEach(id=>so.observe(document.getElementById(id)));
  }
})();
function expandDream(){document.getElementById("dreamCard").classList.remove("collapsed");document.getElementById("moreBtn").remove()}
function goTo(id){
  const t=document.getElementById(id);
  if(t) t.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"});
}
function openEnvelope(){
  document.getElementById("envelope").classList.add("open");
  document.getElementById("envelopeHint").textContent="A little letter, just for you ♡";
  setTimeout(()=>{
    const l=document.getElementById("letterPaper");
    l.classList.remove("hidden");
    l.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"center"});
  },650);
}
function showRose(i){document.getElementById("roseMessage").textContent=roseNotes[i]}
function toggleReason(c){c.classList.toggle("revealed")}
const particleRoot=document.getElementById("particles");
const calm=matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
const HEARTS=["♡","♥","💗","💖","💕","💞","🌸","✧"];
const PINKS=["#ff4f8b","#ff7aa8","#f2b8c8","#d86c88","#ffffff","#d8b77c"];
function makeParticle(burst=false){
  if(calm) return;
  const p=document.createElement("span");
  p.className="particle"+(Math.random()<.4?" glow":"");
  p.textContent=HEARTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*HEARTS.length)];
  p.style.left=Math.random()*100+"vw";
  p.style.fontSize=(12+Math.random()*(burst?30:24))+"px";
  p.style.color=PINKS[Math.floor(Math.random()*PINKS.length)];
  p.style.animationDuration=(burst?3+Math.random()*2:5+Math.random()*7)+"s";
  particleRoot.appendChild(p);
  setTimeout(()=>p.remove(),burst?5500:12500);
}
function makeName(){
  if(calm) return;
  const n=document.createElement("span");
  n.className="fname";
  n.textContent="Monisha"+(Math.random()<.35?" ♡":"");
  n.style.left=(Math.random()*85)+"vw";
  n.style.fontSize=(22+Math.random()*30)+"px";
  n.style.setProperty("--sx",((Math.random()-.5)*160)+"px");
  const d=9+Math.random()*7;
  n.style.animationDuration=d+"s";
  particleRoot.appendChild(n);
  setTimeout(()=>n.remove(),d*1000+200);
}
function finale(){
  document.getElementById("finaleMessage").classList.remove("hidden");
  for(let i=0;i<70;i++) setTimeout(()=>makeParticle(true),i*30);
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++) setTimeout(makeName,i*200);
}
setInterval(()=>makeParticle(false),350);
setInterval(makeName,1700);
for(let i=0;i<4;i++) setTimeout(makeName,i*500);
document.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{
  if(calm) return;
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
    const h=document.createElement("span");
    h.className="tap-heart";
    h.textContent=["💗","💖","💕","♥"][i%4];
    h.style.left=e.clientX+"px";h.style.top=e.clientY+"px";
    h.style.fontSize=(14+Math.random()*14)+"px";
    h.style.setProperty("--dx",((Math.random()-.5)*120)+"px");
    document.body.appendChild(h);
    setTimeout(()=>h.remove(),1500);
  }
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
